senses.sense_definition: zich ontevredenheid uiten of een klacht indienen over een situatie of persoon

examples.text: Ik <w>beklaag</w> me al jaren over die slechte service in dit restaurant.

target_lang_translations.en: I have been <w>complaining</w> about the poor service in this restaurant for years.
target_lang_translations.it: Mi <w>lamento</w> da anni del pessimo servizio in questo ristorante.

examples.text: Je moet niet altijd <w>beklagen</w> over het weer als de zon niet schijnt.

target_lang_translations.en: You shouldn't always <w>complain</w> about the weather when the sun isn't shining.
target_lang_translations.it: Non dovresti sempre <w>lamentarti</w> del tempo quando non c'è il sole.

target_lang_definitions.en: To express dissatisfaction or file a formal complaint about a situation or person
target_lang_definitions.it: Esprimere insoddisfazione o presentare un reclamo formale riguardo a una situazione o a una persona.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to complain in a low voice or bad-tempered way

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: esprimere insoddisfazione o dolore per qualcosa
presentare una denuncia o un reclamo formale

senses.sense_definition: medelijden hebben met iemand of iemands ongelukkige situatie betreuren

examples.text: Zijn lot werd door zijn gehele familie en vriendenkring diep <w>beklaagd</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: His fate was deeply <w>pitied</w> by his entire family and circle of friends.
target_lang_translations.it: Il suo destino è stato profondamente <w>compianto</w> da tutta la sua famiglia e dalla cerchia di amici.

examples.text: Ik <w>beklaag</w> de mensen die in deze kou buiten moeten werken.

target_lang_translations.en: I <w>pity</w> the people who have to work outside in this cold.
target_lang_translations.it: Io <w>compiango</w> le persone che devono lavorare fuori con questo freddo.

target_lang_definitions.en: To feel pity for someone or to regret someone's unfortunate situation
target_lang_definitions.it: Provare compassione per qualcuno o rammaricarsi per la situazione infelice di una persona.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to feel sympathy for someone's misfortune
to feel or express strong disapproval or grief over
to express or feel sympathy or pity

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: provare compassione per la sventura altrui
rimpiangere o deplorare una situazione triste

examples.text: De verschillende <w>beklagen</w> werden door de commissie één voor één behandeld.

target_lang_translations.en: The various <w>complaints</w> were handled one by one by the committee.
target_lang_translations.it: I vari <w>reclami</w> sono stati trattati uno ad uno dalla commissione.

examples.text: Na de vele <w>beklagen</w> besloot de directie eindelijk actie te ondernemen.

target_lang_translations.en: After the many <w>grievances</w>, the management finally decided to take action.
target_lang_translations.it: Dopo le numerose <w>lamentele</w>, la direzione ha finalmente deciso di prendere provvedimenti.

target_lang_definitions.en: Plural form of the noun 'beklag', referring to multiple grievances or complaints
target_lang_definitions.it: Forma plurale del sostantivo 'beklag', che si riferisce a molteplici rimostranze o reclami.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: plural of a statement that something is unsatisfactory
plural of a real or imagined wrong or other cause for complaint

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: plurale di una protesta formale per un disservizio
